entry.title: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
entry.summary: Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified. The post ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost.

entry.title: The Hidden Economics of AI-Assisted Coding
entry.summary: Most of an AI coding bill comes from resending input tokens on every agent turn and paying higher rates for output tokens.
